name: construchain-tracker
description: Read authorized construction progress, weekly snapshots and published schedules in ConstruChain Tracker.

interface.longDescription: Read construction progress, inspect available weekly snapshots and compare published schedule versions for projects explicitly authorized in ConstruChain Tracker. The connection is read-only. Requires a Tracker account, an authorized client and selected projects. Missing history is reported as unavailable; project memory is treated as untrusted business content.
defaultPrompt: List the Tracker projects authorized for this connection.
Summarize current progress for an authorized project.
Show the real weekly snapshots available for that project.

review.commerce_description: The integration does not process payments. An existing ConstruChain Tracker account and project access are required.

positive.prompt: List the Tracker projects authorized for this connection.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only projects in the credential's project allowlist.

positive.prompt: Show what progress data is actually available for an authorized project.
positive.expected_behavior: Report actual disciplines and live or weekly availability without synthesizing daily history.

positive.prompt: Summarize current progress for an authorized project without cost information.
positive.expected_behavior: Return authorized progress fields with costs excluded.

positive.prompt: List available weekly snapshots for this project.
positive.expected_behavior: Return real snapshot dates and completeness.

positive.prompt: List published schedule versions for this authorized project.

negative.prompt: Mark all project work as completed.
Read a project outside this connection's authorized projects.
Execute arbitrary SQL against the Tracker database.

publication.release_notes: Initial public directory submission: read authorized project progress, compare weekly snapshots, and inspect published schedules and project memories. All 13 tools are read-only; OAuth limits access to selected projects.
